noodee.name: Noodee
noodee.tagline: STEM Scholar, Analytical Thinker & Student Leader
noodee.bio: A dedicated Secondary 3 student at Anglo Singapore International School with a deep passion for Additional Mathematics, Biomedical Sciences, and trilingual communication. Noodee thrives on collaborative research, debate, and mentoring younger peers.

subjects.name: Additional & Extended Mathematics
subjects.note: Top 5% of cohort; Singapore Math Olympiad Senior Division representative.

subjects.name: Pure Sciences (Physics, Chemistry & Biology)
subjects.note: Lead student researcher in Sustainable Bioplastics & Water Filtration lab.

subjects.name: First Language English & World Literature
subjects.note: Varsity Debater and Editor for the Secondary School Chronicle.

subjects.name: Computer Science & Algorithmic Thinking
subjects.note: Proficient in Python data analysis and autonomous sensor programming.

nadia.name: Nadia
nadia.tagline: Young Violinist, Creative Problem Solver & Eco Innovator
nadia.bio: An enthusiastic and curious Secondary 1 student at Anglo Singapore International School who blends strong foundations in Singapore Mathematics with classical violin performance, digital illustration, and environmental stewardship.

subjects.name: Lower Secondary Singapore Mathematics
subjects.note: SASMO Gold Medalist; excels in heuristic problem solving and number theory.

subjects.name: Integrated Inquiry Science
subjects.note: Designed a solar-powered classroom micro-garden for the Annual Science Fair.

subjects.name: English Language & Creative Writing
subjects.note: 1st Runner-Up in Lower Secondary Storytelling & Poetry Anthology.

subjects.name: Visual Arts & Music Performance
subjects.note: First Violin section in the Anglo Singapore String Ensemble.

awards.title: SASMO (Singapore & Asian Schools Math Olympiad)
awards.description: Achieved Gold standing in the Secondary 3 division, demonstrating advanced algebraic reasoning, combinatorics, and non-routine problem-solving skills.

awards.title: SASMO Lower Secondary Mathematics Olympiad
awards.description: Recognized among top Secondary 1 performers in her first year transitioning from Primary to Lower Secondary competitive mathematics.
awards.skills: Heuristic Modeling, Spatial Geometry, Logic Puzzles

awards.title: VANDA International Science Competition
awards.description: Awarded Gold for analytical application of Chemistry and Cellular Biology concepts to real-world environmental challenges.
awards.skills: Experimental Design, Organic Chemistry, Data Interpretation

awards.title: ABRSM Grade 6 Violin Practical Assessment
awards.issuer: Associated Board of the Royal Schools of Music (ABRSM)
awards.description: Performed Baroque, Classical, and 20th-century repertoire with commendation from examiners for tonal warmth and expressive phrasing.

awards.title: Bangkok International Schools Model United Nations (BISMUN)
awards.description: Authored the primary resolution on transboundary plastic waste reduction in ASEAN waterways and led coalition consensus building.

awards.title: Anglo Singapore Principal’s Academic Honour Roll
awards.description: Maintained above 90% average across Mathematics, Science, English, and Mandarin during her transition into Secondary 1.

awards.title: HSK Level 5 Chinese Proficiency Test
awards.description: Passed HSK Level 5 with high distinction, demonstrating advanced reading comprehension, essay writing, and oral fluency in Mandarin.

ccas.title: Student Council & Peer Tutoring Society
ccas.detail: Organizes school-wide cultural days, leads orientation for incoming Secondary 1 students, and coordinates weekly Math & Science peer study clinics.

ccas.title: Anglo Singapore Chamber String Ensemble
ccas.detail: Performs at annual Speech Day concerts, festive showcases, and charity music recitals across Bangkok campuses.

ccas.title: Varsity Badminton Team
ccas.detail: Competes in inter-international school friendly tournaments, fostering discipline, agility, and court strategy.

ccas.title: Green Campus & Sustainability Club
ccas.detail: Designs bilingual visual campaigns for zero-waste lunches and tracks paper recycling metrics across Lower Secondary homerooms.

projects.title: “Read & Spark” Bilingual STEM Picture Books for Rural Schools
projects.description: A joint sister initiative where Noodee wrote accessible science stories in English and Thai while Nadia illustrated every chapter. Together they raised funds to print and donate 350 copies to rural primary libraries.
projects.skills: Bilingual Storytelling, Book Illustration, Community Fundraising

projects.title: Biodegradable Packaging Film from Mango Peel Pectin
projects.description: Investigated tensile strength and soil decomposition rates of pectin-based bioplastics extracted from agricultural fruit waste as an eco-friendly alternative to single-use LDPE wraps.
projects.skills: Polymer Chemistry, Statistical Analysis, Lab Protocol

projects.title: “Voices of the Chao Phraya” Digital Art & Acoustic Series
projects.result: Featured in Annual School Arts Exhibition
projects.description: A multimedia portfolio combining 6 digital watercolor illustrations of Bangkok river heritage paired with an original solo violin arrangement recorded in the school auditorium.
projects.skills: Procreate Digital Painting, Audio Recording, Cultural Research

projects.title: Smart Classroom Air Quality & CO2 Alert Dashboard
projects.description: Built an IoT sensor node using Python and microcontrollers to monitor PM2.5 and CO2 levels in classrooms, alerting teachers when ventilation is needed to keep students alert.
